title: Picking up a custom eggless cake before work? Riverstone opens at 6am.
summary:
Most bakeries open at 9. Riverstone opens at 6am, Monday to Friday.

That's not a coincidence. Parents doing a school drop-off or a shift start in Box Hill or Vineyard need a pickup window that works before 8am — not after it.

Every cake is 100% eggless. Six sizes, 15 flavours, any design from a photo reference. Order 48 hours ahead — fresh baking doesn't happen faster than that.

Free parking at the shopping centre. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
keywords: Riverstone Box Hill Vineyard early pickup
